objective: Complete the explicitly pinned mod-quality dungeon, quest or boss scenario. Use provider navigation targets for deterministic traversal. Choose battle/menu/semantic actions from actual source state. Escalate when the existing confidence gate rejects a decision. A path traversal or action budget alone is not scenario completion.

awareness.basis: Recovered SID Game RAM decoder and Bot BFS planner; exact provider/source/ROM/ELF installation manifest required.

notes: A local explicit provider manifest is generated with python3 -m tools.playtester.rpg_adapter. External provider source, ROM, ELF, compiler and saves are not included in the repository.

RPGNavigationAdapter prepares only the caller's bounded boot recipe. Same-map targets are supplied by game configuration. Cross-map route discovery remains the provider/game configuration's responsibility.
Wrap the adapter with ScenarioAdapter using actual source milestone predicates and use the existing DecisionPolicy/System2 policies and campaign resource limits.
Native checkpoint resume must match the exact game version and provider manifest. Ordinary saves and native checkpoints are different startpoint kinds.
The mod_quality contract compares retained original and candidate observation events at matched proven boundaries. Missing objective/reachability evidence stays unknown.
